mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to a monetary policy tightening response from the Fed and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but FEDFUNDS does not rise by >25bp in the following 3 months, or SPX 20-day returns are positive >50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines by >2% in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate by more than 50 basis points in a single month signals an abrupt monetary tightening that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises by >50bp in 1 month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series HOUST is rising and the unemployment rate UNRATE is falling simultaneously, it signals a strong demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rising and UNRATE falling simultaneously, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate UNRATE is above 6% and rising, it signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6% and rising, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate FEDFUNDS is above 4% and the consumer price index CPIAUCSL is rising by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a high inflation environment that will lead to monetary policy tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL rising > 2% y-o-y, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive >40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real consumer spending RSAFS, declining by more than 2% month-over-month, signals a rapid demand slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines by >2% m-o-m but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive >50% of the time.
